experiment: Gaussian footprint tuning and downstream policy selection
selection: Keep the 4000-frame checkpoint and original Gaussian render for policy evaluation; retain the tuned scene for higher-fidelity geometry renders.
interpretation: Held-out render PSNR and closed-loop localization robustness are different objectives. The footprint change improves view reconstruction but shifts the composited policy input.
limitations: All robot composites remain appearance-only because simulated and HOI4D cameras lack metric cross-scene registration.
Twenty episodes distinguish the observed configurations but do not tightly estimate small success-rate differences.
